# Alert

> An inline message that gets announced when it shows up. Put it on the page empty, then fill it in when there's something to say.

`<slab-alert>` · Overlays · built on `[role=alert]`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/alert/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/alert.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-alert dismissible></slab-alert>

<script type="module">
  document.querySelector('slab-alert').textContent =
    'Error: the file is too large';
</script>
```

## Elements

### `<slab-alert>`

Import `slab-elements/alert.js` to register it.

An inline alert with no visual styles, around a `[role=alert]`, so its message is announced when it appears.

Screenreaders announce what changes inside an alert, not what an alert already holds when the page loads. So put the alert on the page empty and slot the message in when there's something to say. A message that's in the markup from the start is read like any other text, if it's read at all. Replacing the message later announces the new one.

There's no severity. The old Inline Alert's `variant` only picked a color and an icon, and a severity is only announced if it's in the message, so put it there: "Error: the file is too large".

Style it through its parts. A dismissed alert is `hidden`, and stays hidden whatever `display` you give the host.

Dismissing with the button hides the button, which would drop focus to `<body>`. So when focus is on the button at the time, the alert returns it to the element that had it before the button did, provided that element is still on the page, outside the alert, and takes focus. Otherwise focus is left where the browser puts it. That includes a click in a browser that doesn't focus buttons on click, like Safari, and a button that was focused with nothing focused before it. Focus isn't moved when the "dismiss" event is canceled, or when a "dismiss" listener has already moved it off the button.

#### Attributes

| Name            | Type      | Default | Description                                                                            |
| --------------- | --------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `dismissible`   | `boolean` | `false` | Adds a button that dismisses the alert                                                 |
| `dismiss-label` | `string`  |         | The dismiss button's text and so its accessible name. "Dismiss" in English when unset. |

#### Events

| Name      | Type    | Description                                                      |
| --------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `dismiss` | `Event` | When its dismiss button is pressed. Cancel it to keep the alert. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type                | Description                                                                |
| --------- | ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| (default) | `Element \| string` | The message. Slot it in after the alert is on the page, so it's announced. |

#### CSS parts

| Name             | Description                  |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `alert`          | The alert, around its text   |
| `dismiss-button` | The button that dismisses it |
